ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity white base to 25% low-intensity black mottling, primarily concentrated on peripheral boundaries.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central lobes consist of contiguous high-intensity white regions; high-density black pixel clusters are mapped to the trailing edge of the right lobe and the leading/distal edges of the left lobe; a vertical band of low-intensity pixels marks the peduncle junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression estimated at 130 degrees; the vertex of the notch is partially obscured by high-intensity water spray/pixel noise.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged serrations across the entire trailing edge; high-frequency, high-amplitude peaks (5-12 pixel depth) are concentrated on the distal half of the right lobe's trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edge sweep on both lobes; the left lobe displays a horizontal-oblique trajectory, while the right lobe shows a more pronounced vertical-oblique sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly textured, high-contrast clusters of brownish-white protrusions (barnacles) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; secondary white circular scars visible along the right trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of dark, roughly parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible in the upper-mid quadrant of the left lobe's white surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant distal tip barnacle colonization; pronounced jagged tearing and irregular notches along the right lobe trailing edge; multiple distinct rake marks on the left lobe ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Specific high-density black stippling/mottling pattern uniquely defining the trailing border of the right lobe relative to the smoother transition on the left lobe.
